import requests, re
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, cross_val_predict
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

SUBS=[("P05067","APP"),("P51693","APLP1"),("Q06481","APLP2"),("P46531","NOTCH1"),("Q04721","NOTCH2"),
("Q9UM47","NOTCH3"),("Q99466","NOTCH4"),("Q15303","ERBB4"),("P12830","CDH1"),("P19022","CDH2"),
("P16070","CD44"),("Q07954","LRP1"),("P43146","DCC"),("O00548","DLL1"),("P78504","JAG1"),
("Q9Y219","JAG2"),("P29323","EPHB2"),("P54764","EPHA4"),("P98172","EFNB1"),("P52799","EFNB2"),
("Q02297","NRG1"),("P07333","CSF1R"),("P14778","IL1R1"),("P27930","IL1R2"),("P08138","NGFR"),
("P14679","TYR"),("P16150","SPN"),("Q13740","ALCAM"),("P13591","NCAM1"),("P15529","CD46"),
("P78423","CX3CL1"),("Q9H2A7","CXCL16"),("Q14114","LRP8"),("P98155","VLDLR"),("Q15223","NECTIN1"),
("O00533","CHL1"),("P32004","L1CAM"),("P10912","GHR"),("P48551","IFNAR2"),("P08887","IL6R"),
("O60939","SCN2B"),("Q9UEF7","KL"),("P16422","EPCAM"),("Q92673","SORL1"),("O75129","CLSTN1"),
("Q14126","DSG2"),("P19438","TNFRSF1A"),("O75509","TNFRSF21"),("Q9NZC2","TREM2"),("P17948","FLT1"),
("O75581","LRP6"),("Q9Y5Y7","LYVE1")]
B_="https://rest.uniprot.org"; F="accession,gene_primary,sequence,ft_transmem,ft_signal,lit_pubmed_id"
def paged(u):
    o=[]
    while u:
        r=requests.get(u,timeout=90); r.raise_for_status(); o+=r.json()["results"]
        m=re.search(r'<([^>]+)>; rel="next"',r.headers.get("Link","")); u=m.group(1) if m else None
    return o
BG=paged(f"{B_}/uniprotkb/search?query={requests.utils.quote('(organism_id:9606) AND (reviewed:true) AND (cc_scl_term:SL-9905)')}&fields={F}&format=json&size=500")
SU=requests.get(f"{B_}/uniprotkb/search",params={"query":" OR ".join(f"accession:{a}" for a,_ in SUBS),
   "fields":F,"format":"json","size":500},timeout=90).json()["results"]
KD={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,'L':3.8,
    'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
def ft(e):
    s_=e["sequence"]["value"]; tms=[f for f in e.get("features",[]) if f["type"]=="Transmembrane"]
    if len(tms)!=1: return None
    a=tms[0]["location"]["start"]["value"]; b=tms[0]["location"]["end"]["value"]
    if not a or not b: return None
    sg=[f for f in e.get("features",[]) if f["type"]=="Signal"]
    se=(sg[0]["location"]["end"]["value"] or 0) if sg else 0
    tm=s_[a-1:b]; jx=s_[max(0,a-11):a-1]; jc=s_[b:b+10]
    fr=lambda q,s:(sum(q.count(c) for c in s)/len(q) if q else np.nan); g=e.get("genes") or [{}]
    return dict(acc=e["primaryAccession"],gene=(g[0].get("geneName") or {}).get("value"),
      ecto_len=a-1-se,tm_len=b-a+1,cyto_len=len(s_)-b,tm_GP=fr(tm,"GP"),tm_destab=fr(tm,"GPSTAND"),
      tm_gravy=float(np.mean([KD.get(c,0) for c in tm])),tm_beta=fr(tm,"IVT"),
      jmex_acidic=fr(jx,"DE"),jmcy_basic=fr(jc,"KR"),
      n_sxxxs=len(re.findall(r'(?=[GAS]...[GAS])',tm)),n_refs=len(e.get("references",[])))
S=pd.DataFrame([x for x in map(ft,SU) if x]).assign(label=1)
Bg=pd.DataFrame([x for x in map(ft,BG) if x]).assign(label=0)
Bg=Bg[~Bg.acc.isin(set(S.acc))]
D=pd.concat([S,Bg],ignore_index=True).dropna().reset_index(drop=True)
S,Bg=D[D.label==1],D[D.label==0]
FE=["ecto_len","tm_len","tm_GP","tm_destab","tm_gravy","tm_beta","cyto_len","jmex_acidic","jmcy_basic","n_sxxxs"]
X,y=D[FE].values,D.label.values
cv=StratifiedKFold(5,shuffle=True,random_state=0)
p_lr=cross_val_predict(make_pipeline(StandardScaler(),LogisticRegression(max_iter=5000,class_weight="balanced")),X,y,cv=cv,method="predict_proba")[:,1]
auc_lr=roc_auc_score(y,p_lr); auc_refs=roc_auc_score(y,D.n_refs.values)
print(f"n_sub={y.sum()} n_bg={len(y)-y.sum()}  multivariate CV AUC={auc_lr:.3f}  n_refs-alone AUC={auc_refs:.3f}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,3,figsize=(15,8.6))
P=[("ecto_len","Full-length ectodomain (aa)",True),("tm_len","TM helix length (aa)",False),
   ("tm_destab","TM G/P/S/T/A/N/D fraction (helix-destabilising)",False),("tm_GP","TM Gly+Pro fraction",False),
   ("jmcy_basic","Cytoplasmic juxtamembrane Lys+Arg fraction",False),("n_refs","UniProt references per protein",True)]
for a,(c,lab,lg) in zip(ax.ravel(),P):
    bins=np.logspace(0,np.log10(D[c].max()+1),40) if lg else 35
    a.hist(Bg[c],bins=bins,density=True,alpha=.55,color="#8c9bab",label=f"unlabeled type I (n={len(Bg)})")
    a.hist(S[c],bins=bins,density=True,alpha=.65,color="#c0392b",label=f"reported substrates (n={len(S)})")
    if lg: a.set_xscale("log")
    v=roc_auc_score(y,D[c].values)
    a.set_title(f"{lab}\nAUC = {v:.2f}",fontsize=10); a.set_ylabel("density"); a.legend(fontsize=7)
fig.suptitle("Proposed gamma-secretase substrate determinants do not separate reported substrates from other human type I proteins.\n"
  f"All 10 features combined, 5-fold CV AUC = {auc_lr:.2f}; how often a protein has been studied (reference count) alone gives AUC = {auc_refs:.2f}",fontsize=11.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
